frequency_question: How often do announced tariffs actually go into effect within the specified window rather than being averted by negotiation?
membership_rule: Includes formal executive announcements of specific tariff rates on specific import sectors from a contiguous allied trade partner; excludes broad multilateral rhetoric or indefinite studies.
window: Four months from announcement to implementation deadline

cases.name: U.S. Section 232 steel/aluminum tariffs on Canada/Mexico (2018)
U.S. threatened tariffs on Mexico over immigration (2019)
U.S. threatened renewal of aluminum tariffs on Canada (2020)
U.S. steel/aluminum tariff re-impositions/threats in bilateral disputes

coverage_note: 4 named; represents the complete set of comparable high-stakes bilateral tariff brinkmanship events in recent regional trade history.
known_gaps: Sample size is small due to the rarity of extreme tariff threats between closely integrated partners.
skeleton: Selected high-profile bilateral tariff escalations within North American trade relations over the past decade
validity_reason: Trade policy frameworks and executive tariff authorities remain relatively stable over multi-year horizons.
